age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) These are children who received special education and related services outside the regular classroom (i.e., in a special education setting) for less than 21 percent of the school day. This may include students with IEPs placed in • Regular class with special education/related services provided within regular classes. • Regular class with special education/related services provided outside regular classes. • Regular class with special education services provided in resource rooms. • If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) These are children who received special education and related services outside the regular classroom (i.e., in a special education setting) for more than 60% of the school day. Do not include children who are reported as receiving education programs in a public or private separate school or residential facilities. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Regular class with special education/related services provided within regular classes. • Resource rooms with part-time instruction in a regular class. • If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) These are children who received special education and related services outside the regular classroom (i.e., in a special education setting) for more than 60% of the school day. Do not include children who are reported as receiving education programs in a public or private separate school or residential facilities. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Self-contained special classrooms with part-time instruction in a regular class. • Self-contained special classrooms with full-time special education instruction on a regular school campus. • If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15. Important Note: Time spent in community settings (e.g., work placements, community outings, or other community activities) where non-disabled individuals are present is considered to be a regular education setting.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student receiving special education/related services in public separate day school facilities. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes special education students receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in public separate schools. This may include children placed in: • Public day schools for students with disabilities. • Public day schools for students with disabilities for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • Washington Center for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Youth (CDHY) or Washington State School for the Blind (WSSB) (if the student does not reside there during the week). Important Note: For students attending an off-campus 18-22 program, time spent in community settings (e.g., work placements, community outings, or other community activities) where non-disabled individuals are present is considered to be a regular education setting. If the student spends 50% or more of the school day in the community or other regular education settings, then LRE Code 4 would not be appropriate. For students in regular classroom/community settings for 50% or more of the day, LRE codes 1-3 would be used, by calculating the total amount of time the student spends in regular classroom/community setting divided by the total amount of time in the day (i.e., regular class/community time plus time in the separate special education classroom/school). LRE code 4 would be for those students who spend 51% or more of the day in the separate school setting (i.e., not in the community or regular classroom).

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student receiving special education/related services in private separate day school facilities. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes students with IEPs receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in private separate schools. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Private day schools for students with IEPs. • Private day schools for students with IEPs for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • Private residential facilities, if the student does not live at the facility.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student receiving special education/related services and lived in public residential facilities during the school week. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes students with IEPs receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in public residential facilities. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Public residential schools for students with IEPs. • Public residential schools for students with IEPs for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in separate day schools or regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • Washington Center for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Youth (CDHY) or Washington State School for the Blind (WSSB) (if the student does resides there during the week). • Do not include students who received education programs at the facility, but do not live there.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student receiving special education/related services and lived in private residential facilities during the school week. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes students with IEPs receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in private residential facilities. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Private residential schools for students with IEPs. • Private residential schools for students with IEPs for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in separate day schools or regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • Do not include students with IEPs who received education programs at the facility, but do not live there.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This may include special education students placed in and receiving special education and related services in: • Hospital programs. • Homebound programs-do not include home-schooled students. See LRE Part A Code 31. • Do not include students with IEPs whose parents have opted to home-school them and who receive special education at public expense.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student receiving special education/related services who has been enrolled by their parents or guardians in a private school. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes students with IEPs who have been enrolled by their parents or guardians in regular parochial or other private schools and whose basic education is paid through private resources and who receive special education and related services at public expense from a local educational agency (i.e., students enrolled by their parents/guardians in a private school who are part-time enrolled in the LEA for services through an IEP). Important Note: Do not include students with IEPs who are placed in a private school by the school district.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: Student whose parents or guardians chose to home-school under RCW 28A.225.010(4) and is receiving special education/related services by a public school district through an IEP. (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) Include students with IEPs whose parents chose to home-school them, but who receive special education and related services in his or her resident school district pursuant to RCW28A.150.350 and chapter 392-134 WAC.

description: Student Receiving Special Education/Related Services in Correctional Facilities
age_group: Students with IEPs – Ages 6 to 22 Regardless of Grade Level & Age 5 Not Grade Level PK
definition: (Ages 6 to 22 regardless of grade level and Age 5 not in grade level PK) This includes students with IEPs receiving special education in: • Short-term detention facilities (community-based or residential). • Correctional facilities.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Any Grade Level and Any Age
definition: Students with IEPs placed and lived in a state-approved non-public school by a public school district and receives services through an IEP. This includes students with IEPs receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in private or public residential facilities. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Private or public residential schools for students with IEPs. • Private or public residential schools for students with IEPs for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in separate day schools or regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • This code is not appropriate for students served at the private or public residential school for less than 50 percent of the day. However, the non-public agency should still be reported in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Any Grade Level and Any Age
definition: Students with disabilities placed but did not live in a state-approved non-public school by a public school district and receives services through an IEP. This includes students with IEPs receiving special education and related services, at public expense, for greater than 50 percent of the school day in private separate schools. This may include students with IEPs placed in: • Private day schools for students with IEPs. • Private day schools for students with IEPs for a portion of the school day (greater than 50 percent) and in regular school buildings for the remainder of the school day. • This code is not appropriate for students served at the private or public day schools for less than 50 percent of the day. However, the non-public agency should still be reported in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) Report students with IEPs (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) who received the majority of their special education and related services in the principal residence of the student's family or caregivers, and who did not attend a regular early childhood program or a special education program provided in a separate class, separate school, or residential facility. Include students with IEPs who receive special education and related services both at home and in some other location, if they are receiving the majority of their services in the home. The term caregiver includes babysitters.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: At least 10 hours per week and receives the majority of hours of special education and related services in the Regular Early Childhood Program. (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) The student with IEP is receiving the majority of hours of special education and related services in the Regular Early Childhood Program (and the student attends a Regular Early Childhood Program at least 10 hours per week). If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) Report students with IEPs (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) who received education programs in publicly or privately operated residential schools or residential medical facilities on an inpatient basis (do not include children who also attended a regular early childhood program). Report the child in this category even if the child also receives special education services in the home or in the service provider location or some other location.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) Report students with IEPs (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) who received education programs in public or private day schools designed specifically for children with disabilities (do not include children who also attended a regular early childhood program. Report the child in this category even if the child also receives special education services in the home or in the service provider location or some other location.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: At least 10 hours per week and receives the majority of hours of special education and related services in some other location. (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) The child is receiving the majority of hours of special education and related services in some other location (and the child attends a Regular Early Childhood Program at least 10 hours per week). If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: Less than 10 hours per week and receives the majority of hours of special education and related services in the Regular Early Childhood Program. (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) The child is receiving the majority of hours of special education and related services in the Regular Early Childhood Program (and the child attends a Regular Early Childhood Program less than 10 hours per week). If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: Less than 10 hours per week and receives the majority of hours of special education and related services in some other location. (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) The child is receiving the majority of hours of special education and related services in some other location (and the child attends a Regular Early Childhood Program less than 10 hours per week). If the student is served part-time in a non-public agency, report the non-public agency in Element K15.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) Report students with IEPs (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) who attended a special education program in a class with less than 50 percent nondisabled children (do not include children who also attended a regular early childhood program. Separate class examples include, but are not limited to: regular school buildings, trailers or portables outside regular school buildings; child care facilities; hospital facilities on an outpatient basis; other community based settings. Report the child in this category even if the child also receives special education services in the home or in the service provider location or some other location.

age_group: Students with IEPs – Age 5 and Grade Level PK / Ages 3 and 4 Regardless of Grade Level
definition: (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) Report students with IEPs (Age 5 and grade level PK and Ages 3 and 4 regardless of grade level) who received the majority of their special education and related services from a service provider or some other location that is not in any other category, and who did not attend an early childhood program or a special education program provided in a separate class, separate school, or residential facility. For example, speech instruction provided in: • Private clinicians' offices. • Clinicians' offices located in school buildings. • Hospital facilities on an outpatient basis. • Libraries and other public locations. Do not include children who also received special education at home. Children who received special education both in a service provider location and at home should be reported in the home category.

age_group: Children with IFSPs – Ages 0 to 2
definition: Report those children whose early intervention services are provided primarily in a setting where children without disabilities typically are found. These settings include but are not limited to child care centers (including family day care), preschools, regular nursery schools, early childhood center, libraries, grocery stores, parks, restaurants, and community centers (e.g., YMCA, Boys and Girls Clubs).

age_group: Children with IFSPs – Ages 0 to 2
definition: Report those children whose early intervention services are provided primarily in the residence of the child's family or caregivers.

age_group: Children with IFSPs – Ages 0 to 2
definition: Report those children whose early intervention services are provided primarily in a setting that is not home or community-based. These settings include, but are not limited to, services provided in a hospital, residential facility, clinic, and EI center/class for children with disabilities.
